purpose: Independent source/configuration/cleanup acceptance for bounded pinned-Git read-only handoff transport, not application/build/test execution

challenge_resolution.TR01: Latched INT/TERM is installed before main and does not raise in Popen registration. Every returned child object enters finally; live direct child is killed once and reaped with5s bound. Wait timeout is explicit unresolved cleanup with PID; pipes close in nested finally. Signals during a successful Git operation are checked before returning bytes. Hardkill/host-loss limitations remain.
challenge_resolution.TR02: Incremental nonblocking selector collection checks stdout and stderr caps before retention, polling to a30s per-child deadline. A single read scratch chunk is capped at65536 bytes. Output conversions, JSON tables and decoded-TAR storage are additional bounded memory, not a host RSS sandbox.
challenge_resolution.TR03: NUL, ESC, bare CR and other disallowed Cc/Cf are refused. Checking a CRLF-normalized copy permits ordinary CRLF without changing the bytes actually displayed. LF/TAB remain permitted. Unsupported/binary display is a refusal, not a damaged evidence rewrite.
challenge_resolution.TR04: The duplicate tree-path predicate compares the prefix-stripped suffix used as the map key. Package/tree equality and index/pack/blob membership remain checked.
challenge_resolution.network: Fixed local plumbing with explicit clean environment, no replacement objects/lazy fetch, all Git protocols denied, hooks disabled and fsmonitor disabled. No archive import/extraction, credential inspection, application or network operation is implemented.
challenge_resolution.integrity: Exact expected checkpoint tree checked; regular Git blobs are length/SHA1-object checked and handoff members/index/packs SHA256-bound. Decoder limits, USTAR metadata/type/path checks, disjoint expected blob set, padding and EOF checks retained.

initial_execution_admission_conditions: Root alone invokes the first verify once using the exact accepted script bytes with isolated Python: python3 -I -B scripts/audit/read_handoff_git.py verify. Root records interpreter identity, exact wrapper argv, exit and compact stdout/stderr.

External whole-operation timeout180s; TERM followed by KILL only after10s grace, only for the audit-owned invocation. The built-in30s Git deadlines do not by themselves bound the entire multi-command action.

Capture at most128KiB compact initial verify output; do not redirect large application binaries or extract pack content. Root retains any failure/timeout/cleanup residual honestly; no automatic unchanged retry.

No new toolcache/temp/build/application storage is used. Isolated Python -B avoids pycache; only fixed owned short-lived Git children need settlement. No Gradle stop is applicable to this data operation.

Root announces initial outcome before agents may use this accepted show/list path. Later show/list requests stay narrowly tied to allowed non-stopped findings/evidence and bounded caller walltime/output; no STOP/NO-RETRY/CLOSED procedure reopening.
Rehash accepted source immediately before use and preserve frozen handoff untouched. A changed reader requires fresh exact review rather than silently inheriting this acceptance.
limitations: Source-only operational acceptance, not executed cancellation/failure/negative-control tests. This reviewer did not execute/import the reader or any packed helper.

A successful verify establishes committed handoff transport only; it cannot establish809+2 actual checkout identity, fresh source coverage, semantic reference closure, application correctness, release readiness or a closed PVA.
Cooperative repository/toolchain trust, not hostile-same-UID or arbitrary malicious-Git proof. No global process exclusivity, kernel/hardware RSS containment or universal child settlement guarantee.

SIGKILL/host loss and uninterruptible kernel waits can prevent cleanup. If root observes a residual PID/timeout, it remains unresolved; no automatic cleanup retry or unrelated process signal is authorized.
